privacy: counts, durations, tool names and synthetic labels only; no goals, prompts, args, outputs or summaries

heuristics.phase: per tool call from tool name + args keywords (explore/implement/verify/pr/delegate); bands = weighted majority per 3-minute bucket
heuristics.stall: gap > 150 s between consecutive transcript events while the worker was alive
heuristics.needs_owner: keyword classes over the worker's final summary (device, review-pr, approve, credential, verify, blocked)
heuristics.resume_of: a task whose goal starts with Resume, linked to the latest earlier interrupted task sharing goal words
heuristics.status: manifest/final line; a task with no final line and no event for 30 min is shown as interrupted
